channel.title: The Grant Desk - added in last 30 days, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: added in last 30 days, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily. Each drop carries at most 10 grants, closest deadlines first; the rest follow the next Sunday.

item.title: wpZimmer: Open Call 2027 residencies for collectives (Antwerp)
item.description: wpZimmer · deadline Closed 20 Sep 2026 · EUR 5,000 (excl. VAT) financial contribution per collective, managed by the collective, plus a five-week residency with two workspaces (a technically equipped studio of approx. 18m x 17m and a medium atelier of approx. 4m x 13m adapted to physical practices) and shared accommodation for up to 6 people. Four collectives selected. No application fee.

item.title: Stigler Center: Journalists in Residence Program Spring 2027 (Chicago Booth)
item.description: Stigler Center, University of Chicago Booth School of Business · deadline Closed 20 Sep 2026 · USD 14,000 stipend to cover living expenses over the 12-week program, plus reimbursement of economy-class airfare to and from Chicago, SEVIS and visa application fees, health insurance through UChicago, and housing guidance. The stipend is subject to up to 14 percent tax withholding for international participants, and you need sufficient funds for roughly the first month before the stipend arrives. No application fee.

item.title: NARS Foundation: Curatorial Fellowship 2027 (NYC)
item.description: NARS Foundation · deadline Closed 21 Sep 2026 · USD 3,000 stipend for the six-month fellowship, plus sustained access to the NARS international and US artist residency community and staff support for the resulting exhibitions. No application fee listed for the curatorial track.

item.title: Can Serrat: Visual Art Residency 2027 full grants (El Bruc, Catalonia)
item.description: Can Serrat International Art Residency · deadline Closed 23 Sep 2026 · Two fully funded places: one full grant with a EUR 2,000 honorarium (subject to public funding) plus a private room for six consecutive weeks from 2 August 2027, and one full grant with shared accommodation for one month in October 2027; both include two weekly communal dinners and basic food supplies. A EUR 3,000 production grant and return grants are additionally available to 2027 residents in December 2027. No application fee stated. The same call also offers around 20 partial grants where residents pay EUR 1,130 per month (shared room), EUR 1,745 per month (private room) or EUR 305 per month (studio only).

item.title: The Grey Space in the Middle: State of States Open Call (The Hague)
item.description: The Grey Space in the Middle · deadline 25 Sep 2026 · EUR 375 artist fee per selected artist, plus up to EUR 725 additional for co-organising and participating in the context programme (up to EUR 1,100 total)

item.title: University of Oxford: Postdoctoral Research Fellow in Computational Social Science and Text Analysis (CeDR)
item.description: Centre for Democratic Resilience, Department of Politics and International Relations, University of Oxford · deadline 25 Sep 2026 · Salary GBP 39,424 to 51,983 per annum. Full-time, fixed-term for three years. No application fee.

item.title: IAPS: AI Policy Fellowship Spring 2027 (DC, London or remote)
item.description: Institute for AI Policy and Strategy (IAPS) · deadline 27 Sep 2026 · Fellows receive USD 18,000 and Senior Fellows USD 24,000 as a stipend for the three-month full-time program, plus an additional USD 3,000 stipend on the in-person DC or London tracks, healthcare benefits and a USD 500 professional development stipend. Up to 45 fellows. No application fee.

item.title: CTM Festival: Resynthesising the Traditional 2027 Artistic Lab (At the Extreme)
item.description: CTM Festival, co-curated by Stas Sharifulla · deadline 28 Sep 2026 · Travel budget of up to EUR 300 per person, plus accommodation and catering for the duration of the lab and a festival pass to CTM 2027 events. Visa fees are supported where required, and letters of invitation are provided for visa or funding applications. NO artist fee or stipend for the lab itself. Afterwards, up to two new works arising from the lab may be commissioned and presented at CTM Festival in January/February 2028. No application fee.

item.title: Algorave Istanbul: Open Call for New Artists and Performers
item.description: Algorave Istanbul · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · UNPAID, and no figure of any kind is published. The call states no fee, honorarium, stipend or expenses; it is an invitation to join a local live-coding community and perform with it. Listed here as a deliberate exception to the desk's paid-only rule because it is one of very few live-coding openings in the region. No application fee.

item.title: Ann Arbor Film Festival 2027: Call for Entries (65th Edition)
item.description: Ann Arbor Film Festival · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · All selected artists receive a screening fee: USD 50 per short film, USD 100 per feature. Nearly USD 40,000 in total awards, including Oscar-qualifying prizes. Entry fee for the final deadline tier is USD 100 (the earlier USD 65 and USD 80 tiers have passed).

item.title: Mycelia Fellowship 2026 (Social Resonance Lab)
item.description: Social Resonance Lab · deadline Closed 13 Sep 2026 · USD 2,000 stipend per fellow; two fellows selected for the inaugural cohort

item.title: WRG Digital Call-Out: Generation Xi (White Rabbit Gallery)
item.description: White Rabbit Gallery · deadline Closed 14 Sep 2026 · AUD 2,000 artist fee (split equally if a collaborative group); free to enter

item.title: Voices With Impact: Film Production Grant 2027 (Sanctuary)
item.description: Voices With Impact / Art Opening Minds · deadline Closed 14 Sep 2026 · USD 7,500 production grant per filmmaking team

item.title: Embassy of Foreign Artists: Artistic Research Residency in International Organisation Archives (Geneva, 2027)
item.description: Embassy of Foreign Artists / Centre for Digital Humanities and Multilateralism, Geneva Graduate Institute · deadline Closed 15 Sep 2026 · CHF 1,400 monthly residency grant plus accommodation in a private room; travel and artistic production costs are not covered

item.title: Briarpatch Magazine: AI Resistance Issue, Winter 2027 Call for Pitches
item.description: Briarpatch Magazine · deadline Closed 18 Sep 2026 · CAD 150 for profiles, short essays, book reviews and parting shots (under ~1,500 words); CAD 250 for feature stories and photo essays; CAD 350 for research-based articles and investigative reporting (2,000-2,500 words). No pitch fee.

item.title: MMCA International Researcher Residency Program 2027
item.description: National Museum of Modern and Contemporary Art, Korea (MMCA) · deadline Closed 18 Sep 2026 · Monthly grant of KRW 1,200,000 (approx. USD 850), total KRW 3,600,000 for the residency period, plus a private live-in studio provided free of charge

item.title: LASR Labs Winter 2027 (London AI Safety Research)
item.description: LASR Labs, hosted at the London Initiative for Safe AI (LISA) · deadline Closed 20 Sep 2026 · GBP 15,000 stipend for the 13-week programme, plus food, office space, and flights/travel. No application fee.

item.title: ILIAD Fellowship: Mentored AI Alignment Research (November and December 2026 cohorts)
item.description: ILIAD · deadline Closed 21 Sep 2026 · USD 6,000 per month travel-and-housing allowance for the 3-month fellowship. No tuition or application fee.

item.title: Netflix x NALIP Director Incubator 2026-27 (short film grants)
item.description: NALIP (National Association of Latino Independent Producers) with Netflix · deadline Closed 21 Sep 2026 · USD 45,000 production grant for each of four selected directors to create an original narrative short film, plus individualized guidance, career development opportunities, and an industry showcase. No application fee, but current NALIP membership is required to apply.

item.title: KTH Royal Institute of Technology: PhD, Feminist AI Addressing Gender-Based Violence
item.description: KTH Royal Institute of Technology, School of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science (Department of Computing and Learning Systems) · deadline Closed 24 Sep 2026 · Fully funded, full-time employed doctoral position with monthly salary according to KTH's collectively agreed doctoral student salary agreement, plus Swedish employee benefits. No application fee.

item.title: Pulitzer Center: Global South Civil Society Microgrants 2026
item.description: Pulitzer Center · deadline Closed 06 Sep 2026 · USD 2,000 to USD 4,000 per project. Applicants name the amount requested and submit a draft budget. Funds are transferred to the partner after the agreement is signed; partners file a financial narrative and outcomes report at the end but are NOT required to collect detailed receipts. No application fee.

item.title: MATS Winter 2027 Fellowship (ML Alignment and Theory Scholars)
item.description: MATS (ML Alignment and Theory Scholars) · deadline Closed 06 Sep 2026 · USD 19,200 stipend plus USD 24,000 compute budget, with free housing and food, travel covered, and J-1 visa sponsorship if needed. No application fee.

item.title: CBAI Fall Research Fellowship in AI Safety 2026 (Cambridge, MA)
item.description: Cambridge Boston Alignment Initiative (CBAI) · deadline Closed 06 Sep 2026 · USD 15,000 stipend over 10 weeks, plus roughly USD 1,500 per week of compute support (API credits), housing via corporate rentals, free weekday meals and snacks, and conference costs for accepted papers. No application fee.

item.title: CBAI AIxBiosecurity Research Fellowship Fall 2026 (Cambridge, MA)
item.description: Cambridge Boston Alignment Initiative (CBAI) · deadline Closed 06 Sep 2026 · USD 15,000 stipend over 10 weeks, plus roughly USD 1,500 per week of compute support (API credits and GPUs), housing via corporate rentals, free weekday meals and snacks, and conference costs for accepted papers. No application fee.

item.title: Numun Fund: Seed, Grow, Sustain 3.0
item.description: Numun Fund · deadline Closed 06 Sep 2026 · Three tiers over two years: Seed USD 10,000-20,000; Grow USD 20,000-50,000; Sustain USD 50,000-100,000

item.title: FAS: AI Safety Policy Entrepreneurship Fellowship 2026-27 (part-time, remote)
item.description: Federation of American Scientists (Day One Project) · deadline Closed 07 Sep 2026 · USD 5,000 stipend for the part-time fellowship (about 5 hours per week), plus a USD 1,000 merit award for the most actionable policy memo and advocacy plan. No application fee.

item.title: GMAC Film: Little Pictures 2026/27 (Scotland)
item.description: GMAC Film (Glasgow Media Access Centre) · deadline Closed 09 Sep 2026 · Up to GBP 6,000 production funding per film, plus training, workshops, industry mentorship and free equipment and resource access

item.title: Scottish Documentary Institute: Bridging the Gap 2026/27
item.description: Scottish Documentary Institute, with Screen Scotland and Northern Ireland Screen · deadline Closed 09 Sep 2026 · Up to 4 films receive a full commission with a cash production budget (GBP 8,500 per film in the previous round) plus production and distribution support

item.title: Khoj x Mozilla Foundation: Counterstructures Residency 2026 (Delhi)
item.description: Khoj International Artists' Association in collaboration with Mozilla Foundation · deadline Closed 13 Sep 2026 · Mozilla's Creative Futures: Counterstructures programme publishes USD 2,500 per resident (USD 2,000 stipend plus a USD 500 materials budget), along with weekly in-person work sessions, guest lectures from practitioners across art, technology and community design, and publication of the finished project in the collective documentation report. CAVEAT: neither the Khoj call page nor the Mozilla application form restates a figure for this six-week Delhi edition, and the published package covers the ten-week format, so confirm the amount with Khoj before applying. No application fee.

item.title: ERA:AI Fellowship 2027 (Winter cohort, Cambridge)
item.description: ERA Fellowship · deadline Closed 13 Sep 2026 · GBP 10,000 stipend for the 10-week fellowship, plus visa support, travel expense coverage and meals during working hours. Top performers can receive 6+ month extensions through the Research Scholars programme. No application fee.
